notes.title: Small patch notes - v.003
notes.notes: After getting feedback from player and investigating we finally managed to fix the reoccurring crash.

notes.title: Small patch notes - v.002
notes.notes:
After receiving a bunch of feedback from you, we were finally able to tackle the issues that were brought up. Thanks for letting us improve our game.

- Adjusted achievement values
- Added missing powerups
- Fixed the hero skin not unlocking
- Performance increases
- Other minor improvements
